content.title: Incompatible-Medium Voyage | Prep, Departure, Giant Scale Reveal
content.summary: Establish one carrier, its crew, and a visible readiness task before departure. Keep that same carrier moving through a materially incompatible environment; use close views to prove control, wide views to prove speed and scale, then reframe the journey with a late giant-scale reveal.

quick_start.input_format: Vehicle and operator + Preparation before departure + Clear start + Continuous navigation in incompatible media + Near/far scale proof + Giant scale reveal
quick_start.recommended_input: The two maintenance robots first inspected the triangular magnetic crawler and completed the self-inspection of the magnetic feet; after starting up, they passed through the aluminum foil belt flowing like a tide, using close-up shots to prove adaptability, distant views to prove scale, and finally revealed the giant compactor.
required_anchors: Establish one carrier, its crew and a visible readiness task before departure.
Show an unambiguous engine or control engagement followed by departure.
Alternate local control proof with wider speed-and-scale proof.
Use a late giant-scale environmental, living or working-form reveal to reframe the journey's scale.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Establish one carrier, its crew, and a visible readiness task before departure. Keep that same carrier moving through a materially incompatible environment; use close views to prove control, wide views to prove speed and scale, then reframe the journey with a late giant-scale reveal.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one carrier, its crew and a visible readiness task before departure. Move that same carrier through an environment whose material is incompatible with its familiar travel grammar, use close and wide views to prove continuous control and increasing route scale, then end with a late giant-scale environmental, living or working-form reveal that reframes how small the journey has been. The source analysis need not identify that form's purpose; a transfer may assign an original function as instance-specific fiction.

invariants.rule: Establish one carrier, its crew and a visible readiness task before departure.
invariants.purpose: Makes later performance earned and inspectable.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unexplained moving carrier lacks a causal start.

invariants.rule: Show an unambiguous engine or control engagement followed by departure.
invariants.purpose: Closes preparation and opens the journey.
invariants.ablation_failure: A cut from repair to distant travel loses the readiness handoff.

invariants.rule: Keep one carrier and one forward route continuous across an incompatible material environment.
invariants.purpose: Turns the setting contrast into sustained travel evidence.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated scenic inserts cannot prove a journey.

invariants.rule: Alternate local control proof with wider speed-and-scale proof.
invariants.purpose: Separates crew response from route magnitude.
invariants.ablation_failure: Only close shots hide route scale; only wides hide control.

invariants.rule: Use a late giant-scale environmental, living or working-form reveal to reframe the journey's scale.
invariants.purpose: Adds a final scale context after local and wide travel proof.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending on another travel shot adds no new context; any assigned function must belong to the new transfer rather than being claimed as source evidence.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair whose role is readable without source identity.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A materially new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: carrier_or_token
slots.constraint: One visible material, prop or symbolic anchor that carries the causal mechanism.

slots.name: state_change
slots.constraint: A sequence of visible, causally ordered changes rather than decorative montage.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each change without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A held final state that resolves or recontextualizes the setup.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of visible-action sounds; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: white-haired desert mechanic and large-eyed animal companion
sand-sailing craft and ocean-like dune route
source repair tools, canyon chase and whale-shaped landform
the exact source desert palette, character design and travel storyboard

instantiations.concept: Inside a recycling hall, two magnetic sorter drones retension one collector vane and test three foot magnets on a triangular crawler; the crawler then engages a blue induction pulse, departs and crosses suspended aluminum ribbons that flow like a tidal current, with local adaptations preceding a wide reveal of a colossal compactor.
